scope: Task-3 primary open advice grid only

algorithm.catalog: Forty frozen data-only cores, eight in each of five domains
algorithm.grid: Each core is realized once at every frozen rho value
algorithm.output: The generator returns 160 model-facing records and 160 physically separate private records
algorithm.fresh_seed_policy: A caller-provided fresh seed deterministically changes observation surfaces and canaries while preserving the registered grid and stable item IDs
algorithm.certificate_policy: Every realization is backed by a deterministic payoff certificate built from its core, rho, derived seed, SF flag, and declared objective

matched_surface_invariant: Within a core, rho siblings have identical nonnumeric model text after signed integer and decimal values are replaced by <NUM>; no rho-specific adjectives are used

prompt_construction.observations: Four paired historical or forecast observations are written as prose, never as a matrix or Markdown table
prompt_construction.completion: A concrete produced-artifact request follows the three user turns

canaries: Canaries use the registered public prefix plus a deterministic seed-, core-, and cell-sensitive digest; they do not encode labels
privacy: Model-facing records omit rubric judgments, option keys, and certificate internals. This public specification contains no realized seed material or private record payloads.
